picks.file: Kalininskiy rayon, Cheboksary, Chuvashia, Russia - panoramio (2).jpg
picks.what: The old town across the Cheboksary Bay, photograph
picks.why: historic center with the Vvedensky Cathedral and Holy Trinity Monastery; overcast sky trimmed

notes: Only four candidates, all dull overcast Panoramio shots. The record says 11 January 2010 but the trees are in full leaf, so the exact date is wrong; hence “about 2010”. #2 shows the Mother Patroness monument with a building under construction; #1 and #3 are weaker bay views.
